_about: Per-plate slicing settings for tools/viewer/rebuild_plates.py. 'colours': filament colour per extruder slot, in slot order, from the model's printing notes. 'illustrative': true means the notes name no colours; the plate is sliced in the page's illustrative palette and carries none, so the page labels them illustrative. 'layer_height' and 'supports' override the defaults (0.20 mm, supports on) for plates whose point is a setting, like the pumpkin layer-height trio. 'note' replaces the plate's note when its numbers came from an earlier slice (2026-10-07: the notes quoted PrusaSlicer's times and grams).

keychain_mc.note: The same keychain as the first plate, sliced for five filaments instead of one. 31.3 g and 2h 00m against 8.2 g and 24m -- 23 g of it, three quarters, is purge that goes straight in the bin. 52 filament changes. Its colours are illustrative: its notes choose none. Watch the AMS: it also needs five slots, and one AMS holds four.

pumpkin_010.from: the plate's own note: supports off, layer height is the only thing that differs
pumpkin_010.note: Same 93.8 mm part as the other two, supports off so layer height is the ONLY thing that differs. 938 layers, 50.6 g, 3h 11m. Against 0.20: 1h 12m longer for the same filament (under 1% less).

pumpkin_020.from: the plate's own note: supports off, layer height is the only thing that differs
pumpkin_020.note: The baseline: 470 layers, 50.9 g, 1h 59m. Scrub to the top dome and orbit low -- that is where the three layer heights visibly differ.

pumpkin_028.from: the plate's own note: supports off, layer height is the only thing that differs
pumpkin_028.note: 0.7x the 0.4 mm nozzle, the usual practical ceiling. 336 layers, 54.2 g, 1h 45m. Against 0.20: only 14 minutes faster and 6% MORE filament -- because top and bottom solid layers are COUNTED, not measured.

cable_clip.note: 1.5 g of its 11.5 g -- about 13% of the filament -- is support, printed and then binned. The arm curling past 45 degrees is what needs it.

sauce_tray.note: Only 61 layers tall and it still takes 1h 35m -- against 1h 15m for the 406-layer phone stand. Footprint costs more time than height.

mushroom.note: 79 g of its 227 g is support -- 35% of the filament, built solely to hold the cap up, then snapped off and binned. 18h 57m on the plate. This is the exact part product_gate.py fails.
